changes: Existing engines and their data are reused. Only bundled preferred Docker plus macOS arm64 enables this official preparation candidate; existing compatible Podman support is retained.
One explicit user action starts a fixed official Docker Desktop4.95.0 transfer with pinned bytes/SHA256, bounded resumable private cache, digest and OS signature verification.
Only absent /Applications/Docker.app may be published, using a verified staged app copy and atomic no-replace rename. Existing applications, VM and data are never replaced/reset.
Standard non-admin application copy is attempted where writable; actual OS permission failure offers the official installer. No sudo password, license acceptance flag or paid action is implemented.
An existing helper pattern preserves work when GUI closes. Current job identity binds cancellation and cache reuse; verified-download to install/start handoff checks the same cancellation intent.
Actual byte progress and explicit verify/copy/vendor-action states are shown. Existing App engine probes determine readiness, not installer or browser launch.
Bundled-main-window command manifest and capability retain selected-installation checks; no arbitrary URL, path, version or command is accepted by IPC.
User documentation now distinguishes bundled runtime automatic preparation, absent-engine source implementation, unimplemented remote runtime download and actual unperformed OS installation.
